Name: Fireball
Description: Launches a blazing fireball that explodes on impact.

Name: MultiShot
Description: Fires multiple projectiles at once but slightly reduces attack power.

Name: RapidFire
Description: Fires continuously in rapid succession but lowers attack power.

Name: AttackBoost
Description: Increases attack power for a short duration.

Name: AttackSpeedBoost
Description: Increases attack speed for a short duration.

Name: LightningStrike
Description: Summons a bolt of lightning that damages all nearby enemies.

Name: IceArrow
Description: Fires a freezing arrow that slows enemies on hit.
